name: PNB RuPay Platinum Solitaire Debit Card
tagline: RuPay Platinum debit card from PNB — international usage with NCMC transit.
description: PNB RuPay Platinum Solitaire Debit Card is a PNB RUPAY PLATINUM SOLITAIRE from Punjab National Bank. International usage; ATM limit Rs. 50,000/day, PoS/eCom limit Rs. 150,000/day. NCMC offline transit enabled. Valid 7 years.

benefits.title: Personal Accidental Insurance Cover
benefits.description: Personal Accident Insurance cover (Accidental Death or Permanent Total Disability) of upto Rs. 2,00,000/-. Cardholder needs to perform minimum one successful Rupay Card induced financial transaction at any POS/E-com, both Intra and Inter-bank i.e. on-us or off-us within 30 days prior to date of acci

benefits.title: Airport Lounge Access
benefits.description: Domestic Airport lounge program for RuPay Platinum Debit Card provides access to cardholders two (2) times per calendar year per card in any of the participating Domestic Airport lounges. For updated lounge list, refer to NPCI RuPay Website

features: Can be used at all POS terminals, E Com Websites / Apps and ATMs across India

notes: All Women saving account holder maintaining Monthly Average Balance of Rs.50,000/- and account opened under eligible schemes.
